body: High availability means maximum availability regardless of disruptions, and Azure's uptime guarantees depend on the service and are written into service-level agreements (SLAs). Scalability is the ability to adjust resources to meet demand. Because the cloud is consumption-based, you only pay for what you use, so you can reduce resources and cost when demand drops. Vertical scaling changes the capability of a resource, such as adding CPUs or RAM. Horizontal scaling adds or removes resources, such as virtual machines or containers, automatically or manually.
author: claude

body: Reliability is the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue to function. The cloud's decentralized design supports it, and resources can be deployed in regions around the world, so if one region has a catastrophic event others stay up. Predictability covers performance and cost. Autoscaling and load balancing support performance predictability. For cost, you can track resource use in real time, use data analytics to plan deployments, and use the Azure Pricing Calculator to estimate spend.
author: claude

body: Cloud security and governance benefits include templates that help deployed resources meet technical standards and regulations, updates at scale as standards change, and cloud-based auditing that flags resources out of compliance. Patches and updates may also be applied automatically. Your choice of model sets your security duties: IaaS lets you manage the operating system, software and patching, while PaaS or SaaS can take care of patching and maintenance for you. Providers are also well suited to handle attacks such as DDoS.
author: claude

body: Manageability has two sides. Management of the cloud means the cloud helps manage your resources: it can scale automatically based on need, deploy resources from preconfigured templates instead of manual setup, monitor health and replace failing resources, and send automatic alerts based on configured metrics. Management in the cloud is how you manage your environment, through a web portal, a command line interface, APIs or PowerShell. Together they reduce manual effort and keep configurations consistent.
